ideas.pitch: A computer vision system installed in campus cafeterias that automatically sorts and tracks organic waste vs recyclables, generating real-time sustainability metrics for Sharda University.
ideas.title: CampusEco-AI Smart Waste Stream Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning pattern by featuring a live computer vision demo that solves an immediate campus environmental issue, appealing directly to sustainability judges.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning web platform that ingests local groundwater and municipal supply sensor data to forecast water contamination risks 48 hours in advance.
ideas.title: AquaGuard Greater Noida Water Quality Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear measurable environmental impact with predictive analytics, closely mirroring past hackathon winners that tackled localized ecological monitoring.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-powered analytics assistant that ingests Sharda University building electricity bills and smart meter logs to pinpoint major energy leaks and recommend automated cost-cutting actions.
ideas.title: GreenGrid Campus Energy Audit Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical resource optimization with an intuitive AI copilot interface, satisfying judges looking for scalable institutional sustainability solutions.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled walk-to-earn and bicycle-sharing optimizer for the large Sharda University campus that rewards students with green credits for choosing sustainable transit over motor vehicles.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Campus Micro-Mobility Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses gamification and live GPS tracking to deliver an engaging, working demo that directly promotes carbon-neutral transit habits on campus.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and rapid estimation tool for civil engineering students that evaluates construction material choices on campus for embodied carbon footprint and sustainable alternatives.
ideas.title: SustainBuild Material Carbon Calculator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets institutional infrastructure sustainability with a specialized tool that has immediate practical utility for university construction planning.
